run.question: I'm investigating an error in trace TRACE-ERR-X9K2M. Check Elasticsearch and tell me which service failed and what the error was.

report.summary: Trace TRACE-ERR-X9K2M is present in Elasticsearch index app-245-apm-traces and contains two spans. The span that carries the recorded error is service payment-gateway, operation authenticate_payment (span_id span-pay-err), with error.type ConnectionTimeout, error.message 'Authentication service timeout - error code AUTH-4729', http.status_code 503 and duration_ms 5180; its stack trace shows an outbound auth_client.authenticate -> http_client.post(auth_url, timeout=5.0) call in the payment_gateway code. That span's parent is api-gateway's POST /api/payment span (span-gw-err), which also ended at 503 after 5234 ms. In the same index and query window the ten preceding traces (05:16:00Z-05:25:00Z) all recorded http.status_code 200 with 245 ms / 180 ms durations, so the 503 pair at 05:30:00Z is a deviation from an observed baseline rather than steady-state background. The timeout target is described only as 'the payment authentication service' (response body) and is never named as a service, pod or host in the evidence, so the deepest cause is not attributable to a specific object; Jaeger and Prometheus were both unavailable in this Run, so no independent trace or metric corroboration was possible.
